title: Jax Mercer
content: Jax Mercer is a 34-year-old netrunner who once worked for Zheng Corp before a neural implant malfunction left them with fragmented memories.

title: Neo-Shanghai
content: Neo-Shanghai is a megacity of 80 million souls built on the ruins of old Shanghai after the Rising Seas of 2089.

title: The Ghost Signal
content: The Ghost Signal is an anomalous data pattern that appears across Neo-Shanghai's network infrastructure.

title: Princess Elara
content: Princess Elara of the Sunlit Court is the third daughter of King Aldric. Trained as a diplomat but gifted with latent fire magic.

title: The Binding
content: The Binding is the magical connection that forms between fated mates in the Shattered Realms.

title: The Iron Empire
content: The Iron Empire is a vast industrial civilization built on the harvested remains of dead gods.

title: The Wandering Bakery
content: The Wandering Bakery is a small shop that exists partially between worlds. Its front door opens onto whatever street needs it most.

title: The Kethari
content: The Kethari are the first confirmed alien civilization humanity has encountered. They communicate through modulated gravitational waves.

title: The Green Reconstruction
content: The Green Reconstruction is the period following the Great Collapse when communities began rebuilding with ecological principles.

title: Panopticon
content: Panopticon is the surveillance system at the heart of the conspiracy. Officially, it's a public safety AI.
